scope: additional post-layout coverage of combiner_sampler; not a manifest citation
producer: klt pex layout/blocks/combiner_sampler/combiner_sampler.gds sim/tb/combiner-sampler-pex/request.json --deck gf180mcu --pdk gf180mcuD --top combiner_sampler -o signoff/evidence/post-layout/combiner_sampler/combiner_sampler.extracted.spice --outdir sim/.work/combiner-sampler-pex --format json --hosts 9
coverage_exclusions: rings: rn1/rn2 are driven by deterministic logic steps at vdd level, not by the oscillators; ring layout, ring supplies (vddr1/vddr2) and the ring-to-buffer inter-region nets are outside this layout and this run
randomness: deterministic stimuli; nothing here estimates entropy, bias or jitter
boundary timing: data and reset change only far from clock edges (see stimulus.py settling windows); setup/hold, recovery/removal and metastability are not exercised

bodies: the layout's well and substrate taps make the extraction report body_bias 'biased' (see body_bias_status; no floating wells), matching the schematic side's PMOS-to-vdd and NMOS-to-vss ties; the testbench holds the substrate reference at 0 V rather than modelling a substrate network, and this result does not revisit the earlier floating-well findings (#339/#411/#412)
loads: the four flip-flop outputs and xo/ro1/ro2 are unloaded (the downstream digital block is not included); the *n monitors draw no current
noise and mismatch: transient without device noise or Monte Carlo mismatch
full chip: block-level extraction of combiner_sampler.gds only; no top-level routing, supply network or neighbouring blocks
